name: io.github.xakpc/sqlite-mcp-sidecar
title: SQLite MCP Sidecar
description: Agent-safe MCP sidecar for one live SQLite database: read-only default, bounded writes.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: the value of SQLITE_SIDECAR_TOKEN

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the port on loopback only

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the directory that holds the existing database (must be writable)

data_dir.description: Host directory that contains the SQLite file

environmentVariables.name: SQLITE_SIDECAR_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path of the existing SQLite file inside the container

environmentVariables.name: SQLITE_SIDECAR_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Deployment bearer token (a long random string)

environmentVariables.name: SQLITE_SIDECAR_PERMISSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Permission set: schema, read, write, backup, diagnostics, danger-raw-write
